topic: Is Apple EarPods Lightning Connector Worth It?
angle: Does Apple EarPods Lightning Connector live up to the hype — and who should actually buy it?

reviews.title: Apple EarPods Lightning Connector
pros: Zero-latency Lightning connection with lossless audio support for iPhone users
Built-in remote with mic — volume, playback, calls all work without touching your phone
Durable braided cable at the strain points; far tougher than the old 3.5mm version
